description: The true path of the miniature: a bundle tied with a seaman's knot; the sailor at the inn all evening, the parlourmaid who knows no knot but a granny, the groom who learned the knot in the fishing fleet.

moves.see: the bundle was tied with the carrick bend
moves.why: Whoever tied it knew the carrick bend.

moves.see: Tom Pike was at the Bell
moves.why: Pike knows the knot, but he was at the Bell all evening.
Not Pike: tying it needed him at Fernleigh.

moves.see: Sam Rudd knew the carrick bend
moves.why: Rudd learned the knot in the fishing fleet.

moves.see: Ellen did not know the carrick bend

moves.why: Rudd knew the knot and was at Fernleigh all evening.
